description: The phone packs' regions (region_of's 4-degree squares) ahead of the airplane, in the order it reaches them: its own first, then those its track over the ground and its route (from the point on it nearest the airplane) cross within look_ahead_nm, each line padded pad_nm either side (1 nm, the pad the alerts ahead read volumes within, where left out). A shell reads these packs for what is ahead rather than a fixed span of degrees round itself, which at 48 N fell short of five minutes at 200 kt (the iPhone audit's IOS-20). Geometry only, on the WGS-84 ellipsoid.

track_deg.description: The track over the ground, degrees true; null or left out where there is none (standing still), and only the route is looked along.

route.description: The route's line, [lat, lon] points in the order flown; left out, none.

look_ahead_nm.description: How far along the track and the route to look, nm: for the alerts ahead, the groundspeed over their five minutes.

pad_nm.description: Either side of each line, nm; 1 where left out.

answer.title: RegionsAheadAnswer
answer.description: Region names ("n40w088"), the airplane's own first, each once.
